evidence: 6 states: FRESH, AGING, STALE, EXPIRED, NEEDS_REVERIFICATION, SUPERSEDED. Activity thresholds (execution receipts since written_at): FRESH→AGING at 5, AGING→STALE at 10, STALE→EXPIRED at 20. EXPIRED: read blocked, STALENESS_VIOLATION raised — content never returned. NEEDS_REVERIFICATION: event-driven from Provenance on BREAKING upstream change, not threshold. SUPERSEDED: explicit only, requires superseded_by field. Any state returns to FRESH via documented re-verification with source confirmation.
